title: Algebraic structure of Fock-state lattices
summary: We analyze Fock-state lattices (FSLs) from an algebraic viewpoint. Starting from a Lie algebra, we associate a FSL constructed from the action of its generators: diagonal (Cartan) generators define the lattice sites, while off-diagonal (root) generators determine the lattice bonds. This construction reveals that identifying an underlying algebraic structure provides direct physical insight into FSLs, including their dimensionality, connectivity, symmetry constraints, and possible transport and revival phenomena.
